qualification: development only; every registered seed/width endpoint must be reported; no selection
hypothesis: Initial STOP may expose already sufficient encoder content; dynamic computation must improve actual risk-adjusted delivered utility after full per-episode cost.
primary_comparison: dual.joint.dynamic minus dual.joint.fixed; paired source bootstrap and all seed/width signs
factorial_controls: Within each core mode all arms start from identical pretrained parameters; frozen/joint refers to content parameters, fixed/dynamic refers to executed training and evaluation policy.
timing_limitation: Measured local CPU/wall costs with registered abstract tariff; shared-host contention and sidecar costs reported by outer phase ledger; no production latency or monetary cost claim.
scope_exclusion: No natural audio/video qualification, no exact global optimum, no promotion of old v2 or reserved confirmation data.
